biochemPacks.title: Free items and gift packs
biochemPacks.subtitle: Packs made of products plus free items, trays or cartons · each is on the pack's item list, so assembly takes it out of stock and its cost goes into the pack
biochemPacks.dialogHint: The pack is its own item (counted in packs). List what goes into one pack; tick the items given free.
biochemPacks.packItemHelp: Make the pack's own item on Product master first.
biochemPacks.qtyHint: Every item needs a quantity above zero.
biochemPacks.emptyBody: Add a free-item, gift or combo pack. It can be billed once Admin sets its GST treatment with the CA.
biochemPacks.cantBill: Can't be billed yet · GST treatment not set
biochemPacks.cantBillWhy: A sales document with this pack is refused until Admin sets its GST treatment with the CA's advice.

gst.title: GST and the label
gst.noteHelp: At least five characters; kept with the pack and in the log.
gst.saved: GST treatment set. The pack can now be billed.
gst.adminOnly: Only Admin sets the GST treatment, after the CA advises.
gst.ca: The rates and the treatment of each pack are confirmed by the CA (open question Q-23); the ERP never chooses one by itself.

treatment.free_with_sale_single_price: Free with the sale, one price

treatmentHelp.free_with_sale_single_price: the free item is part of the sale; input tax credit stays (CBIC circular 92/11/2019).
treatmentHelp.gift_without_consideration: given away on its own; no input tax credit on it (s.17(5)(h)).
treatmentHelp.mixed_supply: different goods at one price, taxed at the highest rate among them (s.8).
treatmentHelp.composite_supply: naturally bundled goods, taxed at the rate of the principal supply (s.8).
